question: Which three exact cuisine labels had the highest 2025 Delivered-order GMV in INR? For each label, also give total order count and cancellation rate. Do not split comma-separated cuisine labels.

action.query:
SELECT CUISINE, SUM(SALES_AMOUNT) AS GMV_INR, COUNT(ORDER_ID) AS TOTAL_ORDERS, AVG(CASE WHEN IS_CANCELLED THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CANCELLATION_RATE
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE ob
JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_FINANCIALS ofi ON ob.ORDER_ID = ofi.ORDER_ID
JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_FULFILLMENT off ON ob.ORDER_ID = off.ORDER_ID
WHERE ob.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ob.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
  AND ofi.CURRENCY = 'INR'
  AND off.IS_DELIVERED = TRUE
GROUP BY CUISINE
ORDER BY GMV_INR DESC
LIMIT 3;
action.metrics: SUM(SALES_AMOUNT) as GMV_INR, COUNT(ORDER_ID) as TOTAL_ORDERS, AVG(CASE WHEN IS_CANCELLED THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as CANCELLATION_RATE
